headline: 200 billion dong newly mobilized by Giai Phong Automobile may be shifted to real estate with KITA Group?
summary: Giai Phong Automobile's board proposed transferring 200 billion dong in newly mobilized capital into a three-year cooperation with Thanh Tin Housing and Urban Development Business, part of the KITA Group ecosystem. The capital was earmarked for factory upgrades and working capital.
why: Giai Phong Automobile is a Vietnamese vehicle manufacturer, and redirecting capital meant for factory upgrades into property would affect its operations and balance sheet.
